warnings: Automatic labels A/B indicate acoustic similarity, not verse/chorus roles.

Bar alignment is uncertain; review the beat grid before interpreting section lengths.

The final interval ends at the audio-file boundary, not a confirmed downbeat; it cannot complete a harmonic loop.
